course.title: Building Engineering Systems
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: An auditorium has a capacity of 1000 seats and a volume of $6 0 0 0 ~ \mathsf { m } ^ { 3 }$ The recommended minimum rate of fresh air supply is 2 air charges per hour. Calculate the minimum required ventilation rate and compare this rate with the specification that fresh air supply rate should be at least 4 to 5 times higher than the actual rate of inhalation. (Assume an inhalation rate of 2m³/hr/person)

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
